title: 420Explorer AC-1 through AC-10 evidence reconciliation

evidence_semantics.present_repository_evidence: Evidence that exists today for source/model/integration qualification. It is not automatically release-candidate, deployment or live-network evidence.
evidence_semantics.missing_release_evidence: Acceptance evidence still absent or not yet qualified against the exact release candidate/environment required by the criterion.
evidence_semantics.mapped_blocking_findings: Current Genesis blockers whose resolution is a prerequisite for satisfying this criterion.

rules: AC-1 through AC-10 must each appear exactly once.
Current status must remain identical to the authoritative EXP-0.2.6 acceptance map.
All currently mapped Genesis blockers must be reproduced exactly.
All mandatory requirements that reference an AC must be mapped to it.
Repository/source evidence must not be relabeled as runtime, deployment, live-network or Genesis acceptance evidence.
No AC may be marked satisfied while its required evidence is missing or any mapped blocker remains open.
AC-9 and AC-10 require exact release-candidate evidence and cannot be satisfied by historical exact-head milestone runs.
